# Krizaka

> Krizaka is a software studio in Montréal (Québec). It builds its products in the
> open — their code is public, sign-up is closed — on an open-source stack it
> publishes under Apache-2.0: Krizaka UI, Krizaka Java and Krizaka TypeScript.
> Each product has its own site at its own address (coming soon).
